description: A Jetpack Compose Kotlin source file defining a Top Navigation Bar component for Android TV. It includes focus management, layout, and styling for navigation items and a search icon, suitable for a TV interface.

classes.name: FocusablePill
classes.description: A composable that renders a focusable pill-shaped navigation item, with visual focus feedback and handling for icon or text content.

methods.name: TopNavBar
methods.description: Composable creating a top navigation bar with focus management, containing a search icon and menu items, initial focus request, and click handling.

methods.name: FocusablePill
methods.description: Helper composable rendering a pill-shaped, focusable item with optional icon or text, with visual focus indication and keyboard navigation support.
